window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged and returned little dated inside the window; items below were announced 4-10 November. No new SOUTHCOM strike announcement after the 27 October strike could be verified.

stories.headline: Colombian Navy intercepts cocaine and marijuana worth over $26 million in two Pacific operations, five held
stories.body: Reporting dated 4 November says the navy carried out two maritime interdictions in Colombia's Pacific waters that together yielded 854 kg of cocaine and marijuana, with no per-drug split given. Five Colombian nationals were detained and handed to prosecutors.

stories.headline: Mexican Navy intercepts a small boat off Guerrero carrying about a tonne of suspected cocaine, six detained
stories.body: Announced 9 November, naval personnel stopped a small vessel southwest of Acapulco during a surveillance patrol and found 24 packages weighing a preliminary 1,000 kg. The six detainees, the drugs and the boat went to the federal Attorney General's Office; lab tests will confirm the final weight and substance.
